---
title: "Start-up timing"
subtitle: "How long native Maxima takes on this computer"
header-includes:
  - |
    <script data-ctm-coi-bootstrap src="../ctm-isolation.js"></script>
---

This page measures how long the native Maxima backend takes on **your** computer and browser.
It runs the [rational equivalence question](native.qmd#rational-equivalence) through the same
worker as the native questions page: start Maxima and STACK, check a correct answer once, then
check it five more times.

Nothing is sent anywhere. To share a result, press **Copy results** and paste the text into an
e-mail or message.

```{=html}
<div id="startup-timing">
  <p>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="startup-run">Measure</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="startup-copy" disabled>Copy results</button>
  </p>
  <p id="startup-status" role="status">Not started.</p>
  <table class="table table-sm" id="startup-table" hidden>
    <thead><tr><th>Run</th><th>Ready</th><th>First Validate</th><th>First Check</th>
      <th>Later Validate</th><th>Later Check</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
  <p id="startup-environment" class="small text-muted"></p>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const QUESTION = 'native-rational', REPEATS = 5;
  const runButton = document.getElementById('startup-run');
  const copyButton = document.getElementById('startup-copy');
  const status = document.getElementById('startup-status');
  const table = document.getElementById('startup-table');
  const environmentLine = document.getElementById('startup-environment');
  const results = [];
  let environment;

  const seconds = ms => (ms / 1000).toFixed(1) + ' s';
  const millis = ms => ms < 1000 ? Math.round(ms) + ' ms' : seconds(ms);
  const median = values => { const s = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b), m = s.length >> 1;
    return s.length % 2 ? s[m] : (s[m - 1] + s[m]) / 2; };

  async function describeEnvironment() {
    const manifest = await (await fetch('../stack-sources.json', {cache: 'no-store'})).json();
    const build = manifest.runtimeBuild || null;
    const brands = navigator.userAgentData?.brands?.map(b => b.brand + ' ' + b.version).join(', ');
    return {
      page: location.href, measuredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      runtime: build?.release?.tag || (build ? build.kind : 'deployed PoC1 runtime'),
      compilerProfile: build?.compilerProfile?.name || null,
      runtimeManifestSha256: build?.manifestSha256 || null,
      browser: brands || navigator.userAgent, userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
      platform: navigator.userAgentData?.platform || navigator.platform,
      logicalCores: navigator.hardwareConcurrency || null,
      deviceMemoryGB: navigator.deviceMemory || null,
      crossOriginIsolated: self.crossOriginIsolated
    };
  }

  // One request at a time, like a student clicking; the page clock includes
  // worker messaging but not drawing the result.
  function connect(worker) {
    let sequence = 0;
    return message => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const id = ++sequence, started = performance.now();
      const listener = ({data}) => {
        if (data.id !== id) return;
        worker.removeEventListener('message', listener);
        if (!data.ok) reject(new Error(data.error)); else resolve({result: data.result, ms: performance.now() - started});
      };
      worker.addEventListener('message', listener);
      worker.postMessage({...message, id});
    });
  }

  async function measure() {
    const questions = (await (await fetch('../native/questions.json')).json()).questions;
    const question = questions.find(entry => entry.id === QUESTION).question;
    const worker = new Worker('../native/backend-worker.js');
    const call = connect(worker);
    try {
      status.textContent = 'Starting Maxima and STACK…';
      const ready = await call({type: 'init'});
      const variant = (await call({type: 'prepare', question, seed: 1})).result;
      const answers = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(variant.teachers).map(([name, value]) => [name, value.source]));
      status.textContent = 'Checking answers…';
      const firstValidate = await call({type: 'validate', question, variant, answers});
      const firstCheck = await call({type: 'grade', question, variant, answers});
      if (firstValidate.result.status !== 'valid' || firstCheck.result.score !== 1) throw new Error('The model answer was not accepted');
      const laterValidate = [], laterCheck = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < REPEATS; i++) {
        laterValidate.push((await call({type: 'validate', question, variant, answers})).ms);
        laterCheck.push((await call({type: 'grade', question, variant, answers})).ms);
      }
      return {readyMs: ready.ms, firstValidateMs: firstValidate.ms, firstCheckMs: firstCheck.ms,
        laterValidateMs: median(laterValidate), laterCheckMs: median(laterCheck),
        laterValidateAllMs: laterValidate, laterCheckAllMs: laterCheck};
    } finally { worker.terminate(); }
  }

  function show(row, index) {
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    for (const text of [index === 0 ? 'First' : 'Again (' + (index + 1) + ')', seconds(row.readyMs),
      millis(row.firstValidateMs), millis(row.firstCheckMs), millis(row.laterValidateMs), millis(row.laterCheckMs)]) {
      const td = document.createElement('td'); td.textContent = text; tr.append(td);
    }
    table.tBodies[0].append(tr); table.hidden = false;
  }

  runButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    runButton.disabled = true;
    try {
      environment ||= await describeEnvironment();
      environmentLine.textContent = environment.browser + ' · ' + environment.platform + ' · ' +
        (environment.logicalCores || '?') + ' logical cores · runtime ' + environment.runtime +
        (environment.compilerProfile ? ' (' + environment.compilerProfile + ')' : '');
      if (!environment.crossOriginIsolated) throw new Error('This page is not cross-origin isolated yet; reload it once.');
      const row = await measure();
      results.push(row); show(row, results.length - 1);
      status.textContent = 'Done. Press Measure again to time a start with the files already in the browser cache.';
      copyButton.disabled = false;
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = 'Failed: ' + (error.message || error);
    } finally { runButton.disabled = false; runButton.textContent = 'Measure again'; }
  });

  copyButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const text = JSON.stringify({environment, results}, null, 2);
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); status.textContent = 'Results copied.'; }
    catch { status.textContent = 'Copy failed; select the text below instead.';
      const pre = document.createElement('pre'); pre.textContent = text; environmentLine.after(pre); }
  });
})();
</script>
```

**Ready** is the time from pressing Measure until Maxima and STACK are loaded, including any
download. **First Check** is the first assessment of the answer; **Later Check** is the median of
five more. The first run in a browser downloads the runtime (about 11 MB); later runs use the
browser cache, so their Ready time mostly shows the processor. To time a first visit again, use a
private window.
